provenance.note: Arithmetic components are derived from the price panel. Judgment components were supplied 2026-08-26 with sourced reasoning. MID-CYCLE MANUAL RUN: judgment written 2026-08-26, five calendar days after the 2026-08-21 close this file reads. Two of the five sessions in the week window (Mon 08-24, Tue 08-25) had already traded. The three catalysts that dominate the window -- July core PCE and NVDA earnings (both 08-26), and the Warsh Jackson Hole keynote (08-28) -- were all still ahead, and the pinned research snapshot (2026-08-24) carries no post-08-21 outcomes. The week horizon is still not a clean ex-ante forecast and must not be graded as one.

day.unavailable: The day horizon needs daily bars; the upstream feed commits Friday closes only.

why: Archetype 1 leaves Real Estate at +12.3 pct absolute, -19.0 pts excess -- among the weakest in a steady mid-cycle expansion (The Full Regime-Sector Matrix).

The rate backdrop is the binding constraint: REITs are the worst sector in the 12 months after a first hike, and the 10Y closed 08-21 at a 52-week-high 4.738 pct with ~64 pct of another hike priced by year-end (Sector Macro Sensitivity Matrix; wiki/economic-calendar.md@63b4d3ba).
risks: Housing starts fell -12.4 pct to 1.239M, the second-lowest post-pandemic print, with single-family -9.9 pct at 6.65 pct-plus mortgages -- the rate-sensitive economy is cracking first here (wiki/economic-calendar.md@63b4d3ba).

why: The reconciling variable in the research is whether growth accompanies the rate move, and in this window it does: composite PMI 56.0 and GDPNow near 4.0 pct. Nareit's finding is that REITs average better 12-month returns when yields rise than when they fall, precisely in that case (Sector Macro Sensitivity Matrix; wiki/economic-calendar.md@63b4d3ba).

XLRE fell only -0.42 pct against XLU's -3.48 pct on the same rate move; shorter-duration lease rolls reprice rents faster than regulatory lag allows utilities to, which is why Real Estate was upgraded to neutral while Utilities was cut (wiki/synthesis.md@cd85b433).
risks: The panel has Real Estate -4.47 pts vs SPY on the month with 33.3 breadth, the weakest month breadth in the run -- the arithmetic sides with the archetype prior, not with the upgrade (panel metrics, this file).

This sector reports 9 of 10 constituents: AVB was dropped by the 2026-08-21 correction for a zero-volume bar, so data_quality is warn and the denominator is honest but thinner than the rest of the run.

extracts.lead_summary: REITs are the bond market's cousin with a mortgage. When rates rise, they bleed. When rates fall, they heal — slowly.
